title: Closed semantic matched-comparator transactions and evidence

ResolvedComparatorOperation.$comment: Plan evidence is post-expansion. An operation either names a member_id or carries a concrete zero-based member_index; the registry-only EXPANSION_MEMBER_INDEX token is never persisted as evidence.

EqualProjectionDigestPreimage.$comment: The evaluator derives varied targets from the selected operations, flattens their registered write paths in target order with first occurrence retained, removes exactly those paths from a complete ComparatorTransactionState, and hashes this closed wrapper under ebm-audit/comparator-equal-projection/1. The retained_state is intentionally a pruned canonical object and is not asserted to satisfy ComparatorTransactionState.

ComparatorTransactionState.$comment: This is the one complete typed state accepted by comparator operations. Implementations apply operations to this object only; parallel dictionaries, JSON-pointer patch APIs, and implicit generator defaults are prohibited.

ComparatorTransactionTransition.$comment: The evaluator recomputes both state hashes under ebm-audit/comparator-transaction-state/1, requires sequence and pairing_key to match the operation/evidence, applies the operation itself, requires exact post-state equality, derives observed_changed_paths, and rejects any path outside the exact binding.

SharedComponentEquality.$comment: Recompute both component digests from the embedded canonical values under ebm-audit/comparator-component/1 and independently compare those values with the named generator component output. equal is true if and only if the recomputed digests and canonical values are byte-equal; a copied boolean or digest is not evidence.

ComparatorChainBinding.$comment: equal is true if and only if source_chain_seed equals member_chain_seed. The three execution identities are checked against every other chain and the sealed case/result by the four-chain and sealed-case invariants.

MatchedComparatorPlanEvidence.$comment: pairing_key is exactly comparator_id/source_variant_id/replicate_index_decimal. sequence is exactly 0..n-1. Every operation resolves to exactly one ordered_member_ids entry: member_id must be present in that array, or a concrete member_index selects it. varied_semantic_targets is the duplicate-free set of operation semantic_target values.

source_preoperation_resolved_generator_c.$comment: Registered alias of resolved_generator_configuration_sha256. Recompute with domain ebm-audit/resolved-generator-configuration/1 from the complete source pre-operation ResolvedGeneratorConfiguration digest preimage.

member_postoperation_resolved_generator_.$comment: Registered alias of resolved_generator_configuration_sha256. Recompute with domain ebm-audit/resolved-generator-configuration/1 from the complete member post-operation ResolvedGeneratorConfiguration digest preimage.

MatchedComparatorEvidence.$comment: PASS is legal only after pairing_key is reconstructed from comparator_id/source_variant_id/replicate_index; evidence.member_id is resolved inside ordered_member_ids; every member_id or concrete member_index operation is selected exactly once in plan order; and the embedded plan hash, exact selected-operation hash, complete transition chain, both raw resolved-configuration hashes, closed EqualProjectionDigestPreimage, both raw generated-data hashes, both canonical input digests, relation-specific reconstruction from actual data/state, every shared-component digest/equality, and all four chain bindings have been independently recomputed. Caller booleans, witness assertions, and supplied digests are never evidence. FAIL preserves any mismatch and remains in its planned denominator.

MatchedComparatorEvidenceManifest.$comment: For every member evidence object, reconstruct pairing_key and recompute matched_comparator_plan_evidence_sha256; resolve exactly one plan with the same comparator_id, source_variant_id, replicate_index, pair_index, and pairing_key. member_id must occur exactly once in that plan. Resolve every operation exactly once through member_id or ordered_member_ids[member_index], retain selected operations in complete-plan order, bind ordered_operations_sha256 to that exact selected array, and require one continuous transition per selected operation from source_preoperation_state to member_postoperation_state. Declared varied targets and shared components must equal the recomputed operation/equality evidence, and no plan member may be missing or duplicated. Every member has exactly the four ordered chains 0..3; source/member seeds must match per chain and backend, settings, and environment identities must be identical across all four bindings.
